Dossier de preuve · EV-2019-009001

Sycamore executes a large random-circuit sampling benchmark

A 2019 study reported a 53-qubit Sycamore random-circuit-sampling experiment completed in about 200 seconds, with a then-estimated much longer runtime for a classical supercomputer.
